# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Rigi has no tagged releases yet. Security fixes are applied to the latest `master` only.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you have discovered a security vulnerability in this project, please report it privately. **Do not disclose it as a public issue.** This gives us time to work with you on a fix before public exposure, reducing the chance that the exploit is used before a patch is released.

Please use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting: open the repository's **Security** tab and choose **Report a vulnerability** (a [security advisory](https://github.com/BertCh/rigi/security/advisories/new)).

This project is maintained on a reasonable-effort basis. Please give us at least 90 days to work on a fix before public exposure.
